I hear that this matters to you. I did sit with it. I'm not changing my mind.

Calling honesty selfish doesn't make it selfish. What's actually selfish is asking someone to rewrite what they believe because you don't like the answer. That's not a request for care — it's a request for compliance.

I already said I can be honest without being cruel, and I meant that. Comfort still matters. Timing matters. Kindness matters. None of that requires me to pretend I think the opposite of what I think.

I'm not going to adopt a view I don't hold just because you need me to. If that's a dealbreaker, I'd rather we know that than paper over it. Why is the other position so important to you? I actually want to understand that — I just won't fake agreement to get there.
